current.text: The game is up. Beta 0.9.191 is the newest version.

incidents.title: Some friends cannot join on the website or app
incidents.what: On some networks a friend's join waited and then said no host was found, though the host's game was open.
incidents.fix: Beta 0.9.191 sends the game through a relay server when a direct connection is blocked, and says when the host was found but could not be reached.

incidents.title: A cave chest that would not open
incidents.what: The chest in a cave grotto held a crystal block that is not an item, and opening that chest failed.
incidents.fix: Beta 0.9.188 puts Amethyst gems in grotto chests and repairs any chest holding something that is not an item, in older worlds too.

incidents.title: Half doors and furniture on slopes
incidents.what: Some doors in ruined villages, the tutorial among them, were half door and half stone, a few village chests were drawn over a door, and some cave chests sat on slopes.
incidents.fix: Beta 0.9.158 makes every door whole, moves a chest off a door, and levels the ground under doors, workbenches, furnaces and chests.

incidents.title: Black screen on phones in the Claude app
incidents.what: On a phone held upright, the game showed a dark screen instead of the title. Beta 0.9.152 added a card asking you to turn the phone sideways and paused the game until you did. The Claude app on a phone does not turn sideways, so the card never went away, and its small text was hard to see on the dark background.
incidents.fix: Beta 0.9.155 gives that card a big Play upright button and larger text. If you still see a dark screen, close the game and open it again so the newest version loads.

incidents.title: Tutorial: the Quartermaster never finished rebuilding
incidents.what: In the tutorial world, the Quartermaster started the repairs but never placed a block, so the village never finished, the wanderers never came and the Recruiter stood without his room. The tutorial turns off monsters and world events, and the rebuild was switched off with them by mistake.
incidents.fix: Beta 0.9.156 lets the rebuild run in the tutorial (about a minute). A saved tutorial picks up where it left off.
